21:- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Author test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and ga
te pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.
36:- [Local Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test wit
h local results and an MCPJam identity
45:- [MCP Events](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/events.md): List, poll, watch, subscribe to and conformance-check MCP Events (trigge
rs) from the CLI: push, poll and webhook delivery, judged by the draft or the ChatGPT profile
47:- [CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ci.md): Run MCP health checks, conformance suites, and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab
CI, and other CI environments
48:- [Self-hosted MCPJam](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md): Point the CLI and SDK at your organization's MCPJam server,
lock it with an IT settings file, and work behind a corporate proxy
66:- [EvalSuite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-suite.md): API reference for EvalSuite
68:- [runSuiteFile](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/run-suite-file.md): API reference for running an MCPJam suite file local
ly from code
83:- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite ru
n from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `r
unId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in th
e hosted UI Runs tab,…
93:- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest
first.
94:- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytic
s.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest completion first: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-val
ue chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and h
ost.
96:- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-rep
ort.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.
97:- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-
suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of its atta
ched environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-environme
nt suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…
99:- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-autho
r-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite (the suite record plus its test cases) and responds `201` **synchronously**
, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`
100:- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-e
val-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuit
eId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this b
ody is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…
101:- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md):
The suite's full settings: attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups ins
tead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.
102:- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its c
ases. Past runs are not deleted.
103:- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partia
l update: omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reve
rting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated su
ite.
104:- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the
suite, in the public steps-first shape.
